callouts.label: Course Description
callouts.hint: Find the first workshop on the left, a brown cabin with a checklist clipboard and a small dial gauge in its window.
callouts.description: Stage 1 of the textbook workflow. The course description analyzer writes a course description file with a score. The check is completeness against the required elements (Chapter 20).
callouts.tip: Every stage leaves a file, and every file has a check.

callouts.label: Learning Graph
callouts.hint: Find the blue workshop whose window shows blue dots joined by arrows.
callouts.description: Stage 2. The learning graph generator writes a concept list and a dependency graph, 379 concepts for this book. The checks are edge direction, a cycle check, and quality metrics (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Chapter Structure
callouts.hint: Find the purple workshop whose window shows three stacked white cubes.
callouts.description: Stage 3. The chapter structure designer writes twenty chapter outlines with concept impact scores. The check is the dependency order of the chapters, which the learning graph determines (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Chapter Content
callouts.hint: Find the red workshop whose window shows a page of text beside a monitor with colored molecule dots.
callouts.description: Stage 4. The chapter content generator writes chapter text with MicroSim specifications. The checks are concept coverage, the mascot rules, and a strict site build (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: MicroSims
callouts.hint: Find the teal workshop whose window shows a slider above a bell curve and a row of colored dots.
callouts.description: Stage 5. The MicroSim generator writes interactive sims. Each is reviewed against its specification, then given a status. Agents may mark a sim scaffolded, built, or instrumented, and only the human author marks it approved (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Supporting Pages
callouts.hint: Find the last workshop on the right, a green cabin whose window shows a fan of four colored cards: book, question mark, checklist, cube.
callouts.description: Stage 6. The glossary, FAQ, quiz, and reference generators write the supporting pages. The check is consistency with the chapter content (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Source Material and Structure
callouts.hint: Find the tall stacks of papers and books where the road begins, beside a large page with dashed placeholder boxes.
callouts.description: The MicroSims paper was not written from nothing. A status file maps each section to existing documentation, about 19,000 words to extract. Structure came before prose: the abstract, introduction, related work, and conclusion were completed first, and the other sections stood as placeholders (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Wrong Number Caught
callouts.hint: Find the lower-left scene where an arrow leads from a red-highlighted cell in a grid to a dark gauge with a lightning bolt and red needle.
callouts.description: A draft criterion said that adding noise of 2 LSB to an ideal 10-bit record would lower ENOB by 1.0 to 1.5 bits. A hand calculation showed a drop of about 2.8 bits, leaving a result near 7.2. A model wrote a plausible, wrong number, and a sanity check caught it (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Claim Table
callouts.hint: Find the first round sign on the road, with a grid icon above a spreadsheet card with orange and blue cells.
callouts.description: The working abstract cited gains of up to 30 to 40 percent from simulations, while a figure showed expected benefits. A reviewer will ask which numbers are measured, which are cited, and which are projections. Trace every number to a source and label it measured, cited, or expected (Chapter 20).
callouts.tip: Measured, cited, or expected: name which one.

callouts.label: Stray Markup Caught
callouts.hint: Find the lower scene with a large magnifying glass over a page, showing red and purple dashed boxes and a green wavy line.
callouts.description: Several chapter drafts left stray closing tags after note blocks. The site still built, so nothing looked broken. A validation script that counted opening and closing tags found the defect, a mechanical check in place of a careful reading (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Short Chapters Accepted
callouts.hint: Find the lower scene with a wooden arch topped by balance scales, a green check, a green and tan bar, and three of four gold stars.
callouts.description: The chapter generator sets a word target for each concept from its importance score, and several chapters came out well below the summed targets. The recorded decision was to accept shorter chapters with worked examples and specified simulations, and not to pad with restatement (Chapter 20).

callouts.label: Unbuilt Sims Marked
callouts.hint: Find the lower-right scene with a dashed outline cube on a scaffold platform, a glowing red button above, and a striped barrier with a traffic cone.
callouts.description: The chapters specify many simulations. Until they are built, verified, and reviewed, the pages show specifications only, and the status field says so. The honest state of the work is part of its documentation (Chapter 20).
callouts.tip: Agents mark a sim built. Only the human author marks it approved.
